entities.name: Gábor Szetey

entities.summary: Gábor Szetey is a Hungarian former politician and former Secretary of State for Human Resources in the Gyurcsány government, a role he held from July 2006 to April 2009. He was the first openly gay Hungarian government member. He currently lives in north of chicago.
